MECHANISM: GRU width pruning with full temporal resolution

HYPOTHESIS: A 112-unit GRU processing all 32 frames will retain at least 85% validation accuracy while reducing recurrent MACs by approximately 22%, isolating hidden-width reduction from the failed 24-frame subsampling.

INTENDED_EDIT: Reduce the GRU hidden state, temporal summary, and classifier input width from 128 to 112 while retaining the complete 32-frame causal schedule.

EVIDENCE: The 128-unit, 32-step baseline achieved 87.24% accuracy, while changing both width and schedule to 112 units and 24 steps achieved 83.44%; restoring all frames tests the safer single-variable cost reduction.
